subject: Does ShinyApps have some problem with date formats/dates?

messages.author: c7a0fcb2b10f5e52
messages.subject: Does ShinyApps have some problem with date formats/dates?
parts:
Hi. First post here, be gentle.

I have an issue, and the tutorial told me to come here for advice.

The issue is: When I do

output$date <- renderText({as.numeric(as.Date("22 March 2014", "%d %b "Y"))})

locally, I get "16151" in the output.

When I deploy the app to ShinyApps, I get "NA". And no matter what I try - e.g. dmy, other types of date formats - the result is the same. Locally, the stuff works, on ShinyApps it doesn't. Does ShinyApps have some problem with date formats/dates?

Cheers and thanks in advance for the help,
Iga

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Does ShinyApps have some problem with date formats/dates?
parts:
The issue is that apps running on ShinyApps do not have any locale set (or more precisely apps on ShinyApps use a generic non-country/language specific locale, that does not have LC_TIME set). This breaks using some strfime() parameters including %b.

As work around, you can use %m for the numeric representation of the month.

This is an issue we hope to correct in the future, by detecting locale information from the client, and using the same locale on the server.

-Andy
